tutorial.dialogo_0: Hello! I'm a Forest Ranger and I'll give you some instructions. Are you ready?
tutorial.dialogo_1: To walk, use the keys: A to go left, D for right, S for back and W for forward.
tutorial.dialogo_2: With the mentioned keys you will be able to walk and explore the Forest. Now let's practice.
tutorial.dialogo_3: You must follow me and walk forward to collect the red spheres. Let's go!
tutorial.dialogo_4: You learn very fast! But do you know how to run?
tutorial.dialogo_5: You don't? Well, it's easy, you just have to press Shift while you walk.
tutorial.dialogo_6: Let's practice again and collect the green spheres. Don't forget to run using Shift.
tutorial.dialogo_7: Good job! You learn very fast.
tutorial.dialogo_8: Now let's try jumping. Look how fun! Would you like to learn?
tutorial.dialogo_9: To jump you must press the Space key. Try it!
tutorial.dialogo_10: Very good jump! You did great.
tutorial.dialogo_12: Now you can start your adventure.

cabana_animal.animal_0_sentence_2:
Dry, humid and montane forests including mature and secondary 
forests

cabana_aves.ave_0_sentence_1:
Perches exposed at the edge of the forest, glides regularly, 
with flat wings and a fanned tail.
cabana_aves.ave_1_sentence_1:
Active only at night, sleeps under dense 
forest, often on branches exposed to a great height from the 
ground.
cabana_aves.ave_1_sentence_2:
Observed in the humid wooded area of the monkey hill 
of BPP.
cabana_aves.ave_2_sentence_1:
Small flocks, often forage in open fields, characteristically 
raising the tail halfway.
cabana_aves.ave_2_sentence_2:
Observed in the surroundings of the reservoirs and humid 
areas of BPP.
cabana_aves.ave_3_sentence_1:
Found alone or in pairs, generally noisy and conspicuous. 
Pursues a wide variety of insects, also feeds 
on fruit.
cabana_aves.ave_4_sentence_1:
Sighted on fences at the roadside and in 
semi-cleared places, flight in the open sky is fast and 
direct.
cabana_aves.ave_4_sentence_2:
Low and arid areas with trees, from the reservoirs to 
the viewpoints.
cabana_aves.ave_5_sentence_1:
Usually perches high in the trees. Inspects and scours 
trunks and branches in search of insects but also 
eats fruit and hunts insects in the air.
cabana_aves.ave_6_sentence_1:
Feeds mainly on insects that it captures with its 
aerial swoops, also consumes fruit.
cabana_aves.ave_7_sentence_1:
Territorial and competitive, feeding on the nectar of flowers, 
helping to pollinate them. The male in courtship performs a 
vertical flight with steep dives.
cabana_aves.ave_8_sentence_1:
Usually in pairs or small groups, foraging for 
food in various strata.
cabana_aves.ave_8_sentence_2: Observed in wooded areas of BPP.
cabana_aves.ave_10_sentence_1:
Often in pairs, it regularly raises its crown feathers to 
form a round, fluffy crest 
while bobbing its head alertly.
cabana_aves.ave_10_sentence_2: Observed in the wooded areas of the BPP.
cabana_aves.ave_11_sentence_1:
Feeds mainly on large insects like 
Cicadas, hitting them against a branch or the ground before 
eating them, also consumes small amounts of fruit.
cabana_aves.ave_12_sentence_2: Observed on the firebreaks and dirt roads of the BPP.
cabana_aves.ave_13_sentence_1:
Bold and easy to observe. It mainly appears in 
pairs and feeds in low and intermediate strata. Sometimes, 
in mixed and scattered flocks.
cabana_aves.ave_14_sentence_1:
Usually remains perched while analyzing its surroundings 
performing a pendulum movement of the tail.

first_challenge.sentence_0: Hello, I'm Paco! And I welcome you to the Prosperina Protected Forest.
first_challenge.sentence_1: Explore and protect the forest and its species to become a Forest Ranger.
first_challenge.sentence_2: To interact with objects and learn about the animals and plants of the forest, center them in the CROSSHAIRS on your screen and CLICK on them.
first_challenge.sentence_3: In a real visit to the forest, you need the help of a GUIDE who will inform you of the route, and that there are areas that could be dangerous.
first_challenge.sentence_4: To familiarize yourself with the forest, your first mission will be to find 3 species: a squirrel, an iguana, and a pechiche tree.

conseguir_libro.sentence_0:
Now that you know how to move, we'll give you this book.
In it you can record the species you find in the forest when you interact with them. To open it, press the L key.
conseguir_libro.sentence_1:
To interact with the trees and little animals of the forest:
Place the CROSSHAIRS where you want and CLICK on them.
conseguir_libro.sentence_2: Make sure you find them all to get great rewards later.

second_challenge.sentence_0:
It's time for you to start carrying that book a little more.
Find a squirrel, an iguana, and a pechiche tree in the forest and interact with them to register them in your book.
second_challenge.sentence_1: To interact with the trees and little animals of the forest, place the CROSSHAIRS where you want and CLICK on them.
second_challenge.sentence_2: To see the clues of where the species you must look for are, press the letter P.
second_challenge.sentence_completado:
By exploring the station you have discovered species of the Prosperina Protected Forest.
Continue exploring the new stations and missions.
second_challenge.sentence_pendiente: Interact with the species of the forest to access the next station, remember that we have a great variety of animals and trees.

third_challenge.sentence_0: It has left its burrow. It is dangerous for it to be outside its home, as other animals could attack or injure it.
third_challenge.sentence_1: Explore around, we must save it but it's a bit elusive. Be fast and CATCH it, then RETURN it to the burrow as fast as possible by CLICKING.
third_challenge.sentence_completado: Thanks for saving the baby rabbit, it's safe in its burrow now. Remember that when it's a bird or a reptile you shouldn't get close and it's better to inform an adult for help.
third_challenge.sentence_pendiente: The baby rabbit needs your help. CATCH the rabbit and then RETURN it to its burrow by clicking.
third_challenge.recordatorio: Catch the baby rabbit and return it to its burrow in time.

fourth_challenge.sentence_suelo:
It's time to help our feathered friend!

With this "Wisdom Test" about Trophic Chains, each correct answer will restore the strength needed to heal.

By understanding how nature works, you protect the hawk and its entire ecosystem without the need for negative intervention.

Remember that you should NOT feed or hunt wild animals.
fourth_challenge.sentence_0:
It's time to help our feathered friend!

With this "Wisdom Test" about Trophic Chains, each correct answer will restore the strength needed to heal.

By understanding how nature works, you protect the hawk and its entire ecosystem without the need for negative intervention.

Remember that you should NOT feed or hunt wild animals.
fourth_challenge.sentence_completado:
You have successfully completed the Wisdom Test on Trophic Chains.

Now you understand how nature works and the importance of protecting the balance of the ecosystem.

Thanks to your knowledge, you helped the hawk without negatively interfering with its habitat.
fourth_challenge.sentence_pendiente:
The hawk needs your help.

Complete the Wisdom Test on Trophic Chains to get the medal.

Remember: you need to answer at least 2 out of 3 questions correctly.

If you need help, you can watch the video again.

fifth_challenge.sentence_vidrio: Glass in the sun acts as a magnifying glass and can ignite dry leaves. Always pick it up to prevent fires and take care of the planet.
fifth_challenge.title_basura: Oh no! Look how much trash there is here
fifth_challenge.sentence_basura: When trash gets into the water, animals get sick and can't live well!
fifth_challenge.sentence_0:
It seems that there are visitors who have left trash in the LAKE. This is something that should not happen when you visit a forest, a beach or a river.
Help us to COLLECT it and CLASSIFY it in its respective bin.
fifth_challenge.sentence_1: To collect the trash you must CLICK and it will be saved in your backpack. To deposit it in its bin press M and then DRAG it to the corresponding bin.
fifth_challenge.sentence_completado:
You have collected and classified the trash found in the Forest.
You show concern for nature. Remember never to leave waste in it.
fifth_challenge.sentence_pendiente:
COLLECT the trash from the LAKE to avoid contamination and that the animals of the forest get hurt.
Open the backpack with the letter M and DRAG it to the corresponding trash.

sixth_challenge.sentence_aire: The fresh air you breathe comes from the trees. Thanks trees!
sixth_challenge.sentence_0:
You have managed to overcome many missions and you are very close to becoming a Forest Ranger.
Now you must PLANT two trees in the GREENHOUSE.
sixth_challenge.sentence_1: To do it, DRAG the seeds you have obtained from your BACKPACK to the GROUND in the MARKED AREA.
sixth_challenge.sentence_completado: Very good, the viewpoint is a few steps away. Don't stop now!
sixth_challenge.sentence_pendiente:
You just have to DRAG the seeds in the indicated area.

Go to the GREENHOUSE to plant and open your backpack with the letter M

seventh_challenge.sentence_0: Someone left a bonfire lit that could start a fire in the Forest
seventh_challenge.sentence_1: First FIND a container and then LOOK for a water source to put out the fire. REMEMBER the places visited on the tour.
seventh_challenge.sentence_completado_0:
You have put out the bonfire, and you have prevented a fire in the Forest.

You are a true Nature Protecting Forest Ranger!!!
seventh_challenge.sentence_completado_1: Collect your Forest Ranger badge and let's celebrate with the other explorers!
seventh_challenge.sentence_pendiente_0: We can't get distracted, we have to PUT OUT the FIRE before a fire is generated!
seventh_challenge.sentence_pendiente_1:
There is a WELL near here, but it's probably CLOSED.

There is also a LAKE but we need a CONTAINER to bring the water...

Do you have an idea?
seventh_challenge.sentence_fallado:
It seems that you have not been able to help with the fire. Fortunately, the problem was solved before a catastrophe.
Continue to the next station.
seventh_challenge.sentence_wellzone_0: You found a well! Wells have a deep hole from which water is extracted.
seventh_challenge.sentence_wellzone_1: A bucket is thrown inside and recovered full of water with a rope.
seventh_challenge.sentence_wellzone_2: It is sealed for safety but maybe we can find something useful near the well to collect water. LOOK around.
seventh_challenge.water_logro: You did it! You have put out the fire, you can continue to the next station
seventh_challenge.water_falta: You don't have water yet to put out the fire. Look for water in the surroundings. Bring it in a container!

carteles_bosque.entrada_bosque: TAKE CARE OF THE FOREST, IT'S OUR HOME!
carteles_bosque.primer_nivel: FOLLOW THE PATH, DON'T GET LOST!
carteles_bosque.segundo_nivel: RESPECT THE ANIMALS, WATCH THEM FROM A DISTANCE!
carteles_bosque.llegada_lago: SPEAK SOFTLY, THE ANIMALS ARE SLEEPING AND LISTENING!
carteles_bosque.antes_nivel_4: AVOID MAKING FIRE, PROTECT THE FOREST!
carteles_bosque.aire_fresco: The fresh air you breathe comes from the trees. Thanks, trees!
carteles_bosque.hojarasca: Look at the ground! The leaf litter is very important for the life of the forest. Don't step on it carelessly!
carteles_bosque.basura: Oh no! Look at how much trash is here. This lake is home to many fish, frogs, and other aquatic animals. When trash gets into the water, they get sick and can't live well! This river is the heart of the forest! Keeping it clean helps everyone.

contrarreloj.contenido_perdida:
Time is up, it was a great attempt, always remember to RUN to complete the challenge within the limit. 
You will return to the beginning of the Forest.

trash_classification.title: TIME TO RECYCLE!
trash_classification.sentence: I need your help sorting trash into the different bins. Are you ready to become a recycling master? Open your backpack by pressing M to begin.
